label: Modal ontological case omission, nonvacuity and strictness controls
paraphrase: In two-world, two-candidate models whose frame is reflexive and Euclidean and where both candidates are GOD_4 and concrete: omitting the boxed conditional, the possibility premise or the persistence bridge (each other premise holding) leaves both the GOD_4 de re necessity (NecessaryGodConcreteAt) and NecessaryConcreteAt false; with all five premises both hold; and NecessaryGodConcreteAt and persistence can hold while rigidity fails. Formal models only.
